section: Episode 13 - Off Track with the guide as I went for avernic

steps.title: Excellent for many PvM encounters and …
steps.text: Excellent for many PvM encounters and you will use this to grind an Elder Maul over time. I would highly recommend the 2 alt red X method using a Bow of Faerdhinen for over 160 kills/hour. This does require 2 alts but they can then afk for 25 minutes once set up. They will need to be reset up if you get crashed or a clue hunter does their step

steps.title: Wear a ring of wealth and …
steps.text: Wear a ring of wealth and you should get enough Crystal Keys from this grind to upgrade your Jewellry boxes to the max
